title: Creative catalogue: thirty motion patterns
status_note: The following banks were materialized from the 10 October 2026 catalogue and are preserved here as usable text. They remain proposals. The catalogue's earlier statement that a second film was in progress and that zero twelve-style slots were qualified is a historical assembly snapshot; it is not today's completed-film ledger. This guide does not retroactively mark individual catalogue recipes rendered because a similarly named film exists.

records.mechanism: A slow, continuous move toward the causal detail.
records.check: Keep essential evidence and text in safe areas.

records.mechanism: Move sideways to uncover an occluded relationship.
records.check: Use consistent geometry or disclose a 2.5D approximation.

records.mechanism: Hold the camera while meaningful objects move.
records.check: The frame may be calm; the action must remain legible.

records.mechanism: Track one identified object through a system.
records.check: Maintain identity through every cut and occlusion.

records.mechanism: Look down at a sequence of workstations or steps.
records.check: Do not obscure contact points with labels.

records.mechanism: Rotate around an object far enough to reveal a hidden side.
records.check: Requires true 3D or genuine alternate views.

records.mechanism: Move a section plane while the object stays fixed.
records.check: Plane position must agree with visible parts.

records.mechanism: Separate related parts along meaningful axes.
records.check: Keep connectors and parent-child relationships clear.

records.mechanism: Synchronize two views to a shared time authority.
records.check: Check identical starting state and duration.

records.mechanism: Step through explicit scales with reference objects.
records.check: Show units and avoid arbitrary size jumps.

records.mechanism: Move background, characters, shadows and targets together.
records.check: Apply one shared transform and its inverse.

records.mechanism: Move declared foreground and background planes differently.
records.check: Inspect disocclusion gaps and do not call it metric 3D.

records.mechanism: Shift emphasis from cause to effect through motion and light.
records.check: Keep both visible long enough to establish their relationship.

records.mechanism: A character shifts weight before the main action.
records.check: Anchor the planted foot and use coherent mass transfer.

records.mechanism: A moving prop passes its target slightly and settles.
records.check: Use controlled easing; avoid implying real damping data.

records.mechanism: Slow or hold immediately before the meaningful choice.
records.check: Hold after the viewer has all necessary information.

records.mechanism: Leave a fading trace of an object's path.
records.check: Separate history from simultaneous object copies.

records.mechanism: Move the free degrees of freedom while anchors stay fixed.
records.check: Check constraints numerically before claiming fidelity.

records.mechanism: A secondary part moves against the primary mass.
records.check: Keep joints and inertia narratively or physically coherent.

records.mechanism: Show multiple labeled moments in a consistent composition.
records.check: Label time and avoid implying all states coexist.

records.mechanism: Visit earlier states in order with explicit time labels.
records.check: Do not reverse the direction of a real process without a label.

records.mechanism: Move at the character's height along their route.
records.check: Establish environment and avoid disorienting fast pans.

records.mechanism: Transition between plan view and embodied perspective.
records.check: Keep landmarks matched and use a true scene when claiming 3D.

records.mechanism: Expose an object through a controlled, fair mask.
records.check: Check no unintended answer leaks or impossible ambiguity.

records.mechanism: Trace the actual contour or route in ordered segments.
records.check: Stroke order must match the explanation.

records.mechanism: One restrained pulse marks the input before motion propagates.
records.check: Never substitute flashing for a meaningful relationship.

records.mechanism: Let a character leave while the consequence stays visible.
records.check: The final frame must complete the narrative promise.

records.mechanism: A grounded object passes briefly in front of the subject.
records.check: Do not hide essential puzzle evidence or a discontinuity.

records.mechanism: Repeat an action with a new obstacle each time.
records.check: Each repeat changes a causal or narrative condition.

records.mechanism: Settle into a readable final arrangement and hold.
records.check: Keep the answer visible long enough and avoid abrupt cutoff.
